premise: At night Owl is glum because everyone plays in the daytime; Raccoon and Firefly are awake too, and Raccoon knows the best game.
inspiration: The lonely night-watcher of folk lullabies, turned playful: the night has its own friends, and they find each other.
lesson: Everyone has friends somewhere; sometimes you just meet them later.

en-US.title: Raccoon Cheers Up Owl
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.7 60s} [softly] It was the middle of the night. The moon was high, and {all:face sleeping} everyone was asleep… except Owl {owl:face normal} {owl:pulse}. {owl:face sad} [sad] Owl sighed. Everybody plays in the daytime, he said. When I'm awake, there's nobody to play with. Then, from behind the tree, came a rustle. {sfx:rustle} Two bright eyes. A stripy tail. {raccoon:face happy} [whispers] Psst. I'm awake, said Raccoon {raccoon:hop}. I'm always awake at night! Firefly {firefly:face happy} {firefly:glow} lit up. Me too! [excited] Want to play my favourite game? {raccoon:live} Raccoon rubbed his paws, covered his eyes, peeked out… and BOO! {owl:face surprised} [surprised] Owl {owl:wobble} ruffled his feathers. {owl:face happy} Then he laughed a big hooting laugh. {sfx:hoot} Hoo-hoo-hoo! [happily] So every night after that, while the rest of the forest slept, Owl, Raccoon and Firefly {owl:hearts} {firefly:sparkle} played peekaboo under the moon.

es-ES.title: Mapache anima a Búho
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.7 60s} [softly] Era plena noche. La luna estaba alta y {all:face sleeping} todos dormían… menos Búho {owl:face normal} {owl:pulse}. {owl:face sad} [sad] Búho suspiró. Todos juegan de día, dijo. Cuando yo estoy despierto, no hay nadie con quien jugar. Entonces, detrás del árbol, algo crujió. {sfx:rustle} Dos ojos brillantes. Una cola a rayas. {raccoon:face happy} [whispers] Psst. Yo estoy despierto, dijo Mapache {raccoon:hop}. ¡Yo siempre estoy despierto por la noche! Luciérnaga {firefly:face happy} {firefly:glow} se encendió. ¡Y yo! [excited] ¿Quieres jugar a mi juego favorito? {raccoon:live} Mapache se frotó las patitas, se tapó los ojos, asomó… ¡y CUCÚ-TRAS! {owl:face surprised} [surprised] Búho {owl:wobble} se esponjó las plumas. {owl:face happy} Y luego soltó una gran carcajada de búho. {sfx:hoot} ¡Uh-uh-uh! [happily] Así que desde entonces, cada noche, mientras el resto del bosque dormía, Búho, Mapache y Luciérnaga {owl:hearts} {firefly:sparkle} jugaban al cucú-tras bajo la luna.

rustle.prompt: a small animal rustling in leaves at night, soft and curious

hoot.prompt: a cheerful owl hooting three quick soft notes, like a laugh
